summary: DC statehood advocates are highlighting recent federal interventions in local governance and National Guard deployment in the District, while documenting political support for statehood among members of Congress. The coverage reflects ongoing tensions between federal authority and DC's ability to manage its own affairs. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no voting representation in Congress, and Congress can override any law the District passes.
